description: Generate a coherent product launch package (hero image + N lifestyle variants + optional vertical video) from one URL or product profile. Composes hero / lifestyle / video models server-side; returns assets in one call or a handoff with campaignId to poll via pixeldojo_campaign_status.

includeVideo.description: Also render a launch video (default true).

product.description: Manual product profile, used when productUrl is omitted.

images.description: Up to 5 hosted product photo URLs.

productUrl.description: Product page URL; name, description and images are extracted automatically. Pass this or `product` (one is required); when both are set, productUrl wins.

tone.description: Optional creative direction ("premium minimalist", "playful Y2K"), threaded through every prompt.

variants.description: Lifestyle shots in addition to the hero (default 4).

videoMode.description: Launch video styling: lifestyle (default), cgi, ugc, or skip for no video.

name: pixeldojo_campaign
title: Make product launch campaign
